@graph.name: How to buy from Xianyu outside China with a purchasing agent
@graph.description: To buy from Xianyu outside China you need a purchasing agent: a company in China that buys from the seller for you, receives the item at its warehouse and ships it to you. On H3X Search you find the listing, and the Buy on Hubbuy button opens it on the agent's site. Seven steps.

step.name: Search for the item on H3X Search
step.text: On the home page, type what you want. Leave translation off for model names and codes; turn on “Translate search to Chinese” for everyday words.

step.name: Check the listing
step.text: Look at the photos, the translated title, the yuan price and the estimate in reais, the seller's region and how many people “want” it. Most listings are used items sold by individuals.

step.name: Create a Hubbuy account
step.text: If you don't have one, create a Hubbuy account. The link carries H3xCN's invite code.

step.name: Open the listing on Hubbuy and pay for the item
step.text: On H3X Search, click Buy on Hubbuy. The same item opens on Hubbuy: check the price, the variant (size, colour) and notes, then follow Hubbuy's payment steps. Here you pay for the item and, if any, shipping inside China.

step.name: Wait for the item to reach Hubbuy's warehouse in China
step.text: Hubbuy buys from the seller, who ships to Hubbuy's warehouse. Check your account for the services currently offered (for example item photos) and follow the order status.

step.name: Choose international shipping
step.text: Once the item is in the warehouse, pick a shipping line and pay international shipping, which depends on weight, volume and the line. You can combine several items in one parcel.

step.name: Track the parcel and pay import taxes if charged
step.text: Follow the tracking code. Imports can be charged import duty and local taxes on arrival; rules change, so check your country's customs authority (in Brazil, the Receita Federal) before buying.
